resources.string: Local-first encrypted account & password organizer. Passwords and notes are protected with AES-256-GCM + SQLCipher encryption at rest.
Enter your master password (or use Fingerprint if enabled in Settings) to unlock the encrypted organizer.
Passwords and notes are encrypted at rest with AES-256-GCM inside your SQLCipher vault. Verification is required to reveal or copy them.

CSV exports are unencrypted plaintext files intended for spreadsheet review. Passwords are excluded from CSV exports for your safety; use Encrypted .dao-backup to export passwords, notes, and custom service logos securely.
